description: Named command rulesets. Each ruleset supplies the IOS commands emitted per condition. Edit these in git so a whole team generates identical config; {cgNum} and {cgMode} are substituted from the port group's ChannelGroup / ChannelMode.

campus-access.name: Campus Access
campus-access.description: Standard access layer: dot1x on user ports, portfast, LACP uplinks.

lab-open.name: Lab / Open
lab-open.description: No 802.1X. Portfast on every access port so lab kit comes up immediately.

dc-edge.name: Datacenter Edge
dc-edge.description: Trunk-heavy. No dot1x, no DTP negotiation on uplinks.
